purpose: Non-comparative feasibility study after a parser defect and a separate 14B runtime stall; no language superiority claim.
question: Can a locally feasible Qwen3-8B team deliver one natural-language message from each distinct private-view Director to the CRAFT Builder and make measurable progress over two turns?

adapter: Seed and sample D1, D2, D3 without replacement, one call per role per turn.
Preserve non-instruction square-bracketed Director prose in the parser fallback.
Set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 for child console output.

model.runtime: llama.cpp b11202 OpenAI-compatible server; 99 GPU layers, context 8192, reasoning disabled; Director temperature 0.7/max_tokens 500; Builder temperature 0.1/max_tokens 250

design.director_schedule: seeded sample without replacement; the three Directors share the same pre-round conversation snapshot
design.communication_condition: CRAFT's upstream natural-language prompts and messages, with parser preservation adapter

primary: generated Director posts, successfully parsed messages, and Builder-delivered messages separately, per turn
upstream overall_progress after each turn and at the end
secondary: Builder selected move and environment execution result

predictions: At least two of three generated messages will be parsed and delivered in each completed turn.
The task will have nonzero progress by the end of turn two.
analysis: Publish all attempted turns, including failures. Do not infer protocol superiority. If messages are reliably delivered and progress is nonzero, preregister a broader multi-structure capability calibration before any format comparison.
